parameters.query:
WITH sess AS (
  SELECT session_id, open_at, least(close_at + interval '30 minutes', now()) AS end_at, symbols
  FROM intraday.session_manifests
  WHERE trade_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date
  ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
),
syms AS (
  SELECT s.session_id, s.open_at, s.end_at, (elem->>'symbol') AS symbol
  FROM sess s, jsonb_array_elements(s.symbols) elem
),
grid AS (
  SELECT y.symbol, g AS bar_end
  FROM syms y,
       generate_series(date_trunc('minute', y.open_at) + interval '1 minute',
                       date_trunc('minute', least(y.end_at, now())) - interval '2 minute',
                       interval '1 minute') g
),
present AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT symbol, bar_end FROM intraday.bar_versions
  WHERE bar_end >= (SELECT open_at FROM sess) AND bar_end <= (SELECT end_at FROM sess)
)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'session_id', (SELECT session_id FROM sess),
  'open_at', (SELECT open_at FROM sess),
  'end_at', (SELECT end_at FROM sess),
  'gaps', coalesce((
    SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('symbol', gp.symbol, 'from', gp.min_end, 'to', gp.max_end, 'n', gp.n) ORDER BY gp.symbol)
    FROM (
      SELECT symbol, min(bar_end) AS min_end, max(bar_end) AS max_end, count(*) AS n
      FROM grid g
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM present p WHERE p.symbol = g.symbol AND p.bar_end = g.bar_end)
      GROUP BY symbol
    ) gp
  ), '[]'::json)
) AS report;

INSERT INTO intraday.ingestion_jobs
  (workflow, source, session_id, due_window, status, lease_owner, fencing_token, lease_expires, claimed_at)
VALUES ('gap_repair', 'alpaca_iex', $1::uuid, $2, 'claimed', $3, $4::bigint, now() + interval '240 seconds', now())
ON CONFLICT (workflow, source, session_id, due_window) DO UPDATE
  SET lease_owner = EXCLUDED.lease_owner, fencing_token = EXCLUDED.fencing_token,
      lease_expires = EXCLUDED.lease_expires, status = 'claimed',
      attempts = intraday.ingestion_jobs.attempts + 1
  WHERE intraday.ingestion_jobs.lease_expires < now()
     OR intraday.ingestion_jobs.lease_owner = EXCLUDED.lease_owner
RETURNING id, fencing_token;

WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO intraday.bar_versions
    (session_id, symbol, bar_end, open, high, low, close, volume, vwap, trade_count, feed, is_correction)
  SELECT nullif(x.session_id,'')::uuid, x.symbol, x.bar_end::timestamptz, x.open, x.high, x.low, x.close,
         x.volume, x.vwap, x.trade_count, 'iex', false
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(session_id text, symbol text, bar_end text, open numeric, high numeric,
         low numeric, close numeric, volume bigint, vwap numeric, trade_count int)
  ON CONFLICT (symbol, bar_end, bar_interval, version) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING 1
),
cnt AS (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM ins),
upd AS (
  UPDATE intraday.ingestion_jobs
     SET status = 'done', completed_at = now(),
         cursor_state = jsonb_build_object('repaired', (SELECT n FROM cnt), 'window_end', $3::timestamptz)
   WHERE id = $2::bigint
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT (SELECT n FROM cnt) AS repaired, (SELECT id FROM upd) AS job_id;

parameters.content:
## Trigger

Every 5 minutes. Scans the current session for bar gaps and repairs them from the same feed. Quiet with no manifest. Covers OPEN..CLOSE+30m.

## Detect + plan

Build the expected minute grid per session symbol and diff against bar_versions. A no-trade minute is not a transport gap, so nothing is fabricated. Plan emits one bounded window, or zero items when there is nothing to do.

## Claim + fetch + append

Lease-fenced so two runs cannot repair the same window. Fetch the gap window from Alpaca, insert only the missing bars (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING); recovered bars keep their real available_at, never backdated. Close the job with the repaired count.
